content.text:
Your project already has signing config set up via environment variables. Here's the script:

```bash
#!/bin/bash

# 1. Generate a keystore (one-time only)
keytool -genkey -v \
  -keystore hackerspub-release.jks \
  -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 \
  -validity 10000 \
  -alias hackerspub

# 2. Build signed APK
export KEYSTORE_FILE="$(pwd)/hackerspub-release.jks"
export STORE_PASSWORD="your_store_password"
export KEY_ALIAS="hackerspub"
export KEY_PASSWORD="your_key_password"

./gradlew assembleRelease

# Output APK will be at:
# app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
```

Your `build.gradle.kts` already reads these 4 env vars (lines 16-21):

| Env Var | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `KEYSTORE_FILE` | Path to your `.jks` keystore file |
| `STORE_PASSWORD` | Keystore password |
| `KEY_ALIAS` | Key alias name |
| `KEY_PASSWORD` | Key password |

If you already have a keystore, skip step 1 and just set the env vars before running `./gradlew assembleRelease`.

```bash
# Encode a file
base64 < hackerspub-release.jks > hackerspub-release.jks.b64

# Encode a string
echo -n "your_string" | base64

# Decode back
base64 -d < hackerspub-release.jks.b64 > hackerspub-release.jks
```

On macOS, use `base64 -D` (capital D) instead of `base64 -d` for decoding.

```bash
base64 < hackerspub-release.jks | pbcopy
```

The base64-encoded content is now in your clipboard. Use `pbpaste` to verify.

content.text:
The error "bad key is used during decryption" means the password is wrong. Double-check your env vars:

```bash
# Verify your passwords are correct by listing the keystore
keytool -list -v -keystore hackerspub-release.jks -storepass "$STORE_PASSWORD"
```

If that also fails, your `STORE_PASSWORD` is incorrect. If it succeeds but the build still fails, then `KEY_PASSWORD` is wrong.

If you've forgotten the passwords, you'll need to generate a new keystore:

```bash
keytool -genkey -v \
  -keystore hackerspub-release.jks \
  -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 \
  -validity 10000 \
  -alias hackerspub
```

Then re-export the env vars with the correct passwords before running `./gradlew assembleRelease`.

```bash
export KEY_PASSWORD="$STORE_PASSWORD"

```

When using `keytool` with a PKCS12 keystore, the key password and store password are typically the same (PKCS12 doesn't support different passwords for the key).

content.text:
Currently the app uses an adaptive icon with vector drawables (a generic concentric circle design). To use the iOS icon as the default, I need to generate PNG icons at all standard mipmap sizes and replace the adaptive icon's foreground. 

The simplest approach: generate mipmap PNGs from the white icon for legacy devices, and use it as the foreground for adaptive icons.

input.command:
for size_dir in "mdpi/48" "hdpi/72" "xhdpi/96" "xxhdpi/144" "xxxhdpi/192"; do
  dir=$(echo $size_dir | cut -d/ -f1)
  size=$(echo $size_dir | cut -d/ -f2)
  mkdir -p /Users/kodingwarrior/fediverse/hackerspub-android-prod/app/src/main/res/mipmap-$dir
  magick /Users/kodingwarrior/fediverse/hackerspub-ios/HackersPub/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/white.png -resize ${size}x${size} /Users/kodingwarrior/fediverse/hackerspub-android-prod/app/src/main/res/mipmap-$dir/ic_launcher.png
  cp /Users/kodingwarrior/fediverse/hackerspub-android-prod/app/src/main/res/mipmap-$dir/ic_launcher.png /Users/kodingwarrior/fediverse/hackerspub-android-prod/app/src/main/res/mipmap-$dir/ic_launcher_round.png
  echo "Created mipmap-$dir: ${size}x${size}"
done

content.text: Now generate the adaptive icon foreground (108dp canvas with the icon centered in the safe zone):

input.command:
for size_dir in "mdpi/108" "hdpi/162" "xhdpi/216" "xxhdpi/324" "xxxhdpi/432"; do
  dir=$(echo $size_dir | cut -d/ -f1)
  size=$(echo $size_dir | cut -d/ -f2)
  # Adaptive icon foreground: 108dp canvas, icon in inner 72dp (66%)
  inner=$(echo "$size * 66 / 100" | bc)
  magick /Users/kodingwarrior/fediverse/hackerspub-ios/HackersPub/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/white.png \
    -resize ${inner}x${inner} \
    -gravity center -background none -extent ${size}x${size} \
    /Users/kodingwarrior/fediverse/hackerspub-android-prod/app/src/main/res/mipmap-$dir/ic_launcher_foreground.png
  echo "Created foreground mipmap-$dir: ${size}x${size} (inner ${inner})"
done
